description: Everything Keystone reads out of one arXiv paper: what it adopts, extends, disputes and measures against, and the assumptions it states with a citation, its own evidence, or nothing at all. Works for any paper on arXiv that ships LaTeX source — one outside the library is parsed on demand, which takes a few seconds. Nothing is summarised or inferred; every line is the paper's own.

arxiv_id.description: An arXiv id or link, e.g. 1706.03762

name: read_paper
title: Read one paper's citations and assumptions
